Subject: Request for evaluation audit: Miriam Huang (SWE II)

Neha / Dev —

Quick background: we completed Miriam Huang's onsite on 11/24 for the SWE II role on Search infra. The interviewers gave mixed feedback; the scorecards are borderline but the hiring panel recommended an offer. I reviewed the notes and there are two items I want help resolving before we finalize comp/level:

- Several interviewers flagged domain fit (search systems knowledge) but gave strong system-design rationale.
- One interviewer (Panel B) scored technical chops lower than peers and left a short note that reads terse and lacking examples.

Given the variance, I'm asking for an evaluation audit to: 1) confirm the aggregated score supports SWE II leveling, 2) ensure the negative commentary doesn't reflect bias/incorrect interpretation, and 3) surface anything we should discuss with the candidate before an offer.

Attachments: interview-scorecard-20261124.pdf, Miriam_Huang_Resume.pdf, SWEII_onsite-notes.mp4 (audio capture summary).

Can we triage today? If you prefer, we can loop Alyssa (recruiter) and Miriam for a short calibration call, but I wanted HR to vet the scorecard language first.

Thanks,
Priyom
Engineering Manager, Search

Thanks for flagging this, Priyom.

I'll run a quick audit of the scorecards and interview notes and then compare against our leveling rubric. A few procedural things up front:

- Please confirm if any of the interviewers are cross-functional (PM/DS) — those are weighted differently for SWE II.
- I'll redact verbatim candidate comments and run the language through our bias-detection checklist.

If we find a single outlier interviewer whose write-up lacks examples, standard process is to have a short calibration call with that interviewer, not the candidate, to clarify intent. If there are multiple red flags, we'll escalate to Compensation & Leveling (C&L).

I'll aim to have an initial audit summary by EOD today.

-Neha

Priyom — if Neha's audit suggests ambiguity on leveling, I'm supportive of a one-way technical follow-up (30m) where the candidate walks us through a past project to validate applied experience. That should resolve the "depth" question without moving forward prematurely on comp.

Follow-up summary and next steps (audit complete):

Summary:
- Score aggregation sits at the lower quartile for SWE II but within the threshold.
- The Panel B write-up is an outlier in tone and lacks behavioral examples; no evidence of discriminatory language, but the wording could be misleading for committee review.
- No systemic bias flags detected in automated language checks.

Recommendation:
1) Proceed with an offer at SWE II banding conditional on a short 30m technical clarification call focused on project depth. The clarification is primarily for evidence, not a re-interview.
2) Edit Panel B's written feedback for clarity before packet submission to C&L (HR will take the lead).
3) If Priyom concurs, Alyssa: prepare an offer at band SWE II (range numeric placeholder: 140–160k base + RSU consideration) and hold for 72 hours while we complete the technical clarification.

I've updated the drive folder with redacted notes and a suggested cleaned paragraph for Panel B. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_audit_notes
